cp.meta.title: Commercial Partnerships | Independent Fertilizer Business Development | Euro Agri Trading
cp.meta.description: Independent fertilizer sales agent and business development partnership opportunities across Europe with Euro Agri Trading s.r.o.
cp.hero.title: Expanding Our Independent Commercial Network in Europe
cp.hero.lead: We welcome experienced fertilizer business developers and commercial introducers who bring credible market knowledge and established buyer relationships.
cp.hero.role: Independent Fertilizer Business Development Partner / Commercial Introducer
cp.model.label: Cooperation model
cp.model.paid: Commission on executed and paid transactions
cp.model.notjob: This is an independent commercial cooperation opportunity, not salaried employment.
cp.about.title: Commercial reach backed by structured execution
cp.about.text: Euro Agri Trading connects qualified European demand with multi-origin fertilizer supply channels. We coordinate RFQs, specifications, commercial offers, documentation, inspection, logistics and shipping arrangements according to each transaction.
cp.looking.title: Market professionals who can develop executable opportunities
cp.looking.1: Proven experience in fertilizers, agricultural inputs or related commodity trade.
cp.looking.2: Established relationships with European buyers, importers, distributors or industrial users.
cp.looking.3: Practical understanding of RFQs, Incoterms, payment terms and international trade.
cp.looking.4: Ability to develop qualified, verifiable opportunities rather than circulate unsubstantiated inquiries.
cp.looking.5: Professional written English; additional European languages are an advantage.
cp.products.title: Fertilizer categories aligned to qualified demand
cp.products.intro: The cooperation may cover the following categories, subject to current supply confirmation and transaction feasibility.
cp.products.note: No product is represented as continuously available. Availability, specifications and commercial terms are confirmed separately for each qualified RFQ.
cp.provides.title: Supply access, coordination and written protection
cp.provides.1: Access to multi-origin fertilizer supply channels.
cp.provides.2: Review of specifications, COAs and transaction documentation.
cp.provides.3: Coordination of commercial offers and execution terms.
cp.provides.5: Support for EU documentation, logistics and shipping arrangements.
cp.provides.6: Written opportunity, client and commission protection as agreed.
cp.process.title: A qualified, protected and transaction-led process
cp.process.note: Cooperation normally begins on a non-exclusive, opportunity-specific basis. Geographic exclusivity or broader representation is not automatic and may be evaluated later based on performance and real market opportunities.
cp.protection.title: Clear terms before protected details are exchanged
cp.protection.intro: Commercial responsibilities and protections are documented before a qualified opportunity advances.
cp.protection.1: Commission terms are agreed in writing for each opportunity or defined cooperation scope.
cp.protection.2: Introduced relationships may be protected through confidentiality, non-circumvention and repeat-order provisions.
cp.protection.3: Commission entitlement is linked to transactions that are executed and paid.
cp.protection.4: Applicants are not asked to disclose client names during the initial application stage.
cp.form.title: Apply as a Commercial Partner
cp.form.intro: Share a concise professional profile. Do not include confidential client or supplier names at this stage. A CV or file upload is not required.
cp.form.confidentiality: Applications are reviewed privately and are not displayed publicly.
cp.form.name: Full Name
cp.form.summaryHelp: 80–1,600 characters. Do not include confidential names.
cp.form.transactionHelp: Describe the product, market and your role without naming clients.
cp.form.challengeHelp: A simple check helps us prevent automated submissions.
cp.form.commissionConfirm: I understand and accept that this is independent, commission-only cooperation with no fixed salary or monthly allowance.
cp.form.relationshipConfirm: I confirm that I have existing professional relationships in the European fertilizer or agricultural-input market.
